rootCauses: Canonical backend had no report_advisor_payment operation and browser reportClientPayment collapsed reporting into apply_payment.
SIGA/CRM direct-payment rows exposed batch automatic reconciliation semantics but no required individual Conciliar fallback.
R5 synthetic proof used one authorized actor on its own advisor scope and therefore could not prove Dirección/Operativo cross-advisor Apply Payment.
Cobros filter/state rerenders recomputed portfolio KPI and aging aggregates on every UI change instead of reusing already hydrated base aggregates.
Receipt/Cliente360 surfaces did not distinguish advisor-reported payment from CLIENT_PORTAL intake.

behavior.advisorReport: Creates PENDIENTE_VALIDACION_OPERATIVA evidence and deterministic linked Ops management; does not create Cobro or mark receipt paid.
behavior.advisorApply: Denied while active role is Asesor/Comercial.
behavior.operativeApply: Authorized privileged role can validate/apply advisor report or directly apply payment received by Operativo without second approval.
behavior.reconciliation: Individual reconcile_payment enriches/materializes the same canonical payment idempotently; batch path remains available.
behavior.temporalEdit: Individual reconciliation modal can complete payment facts and insurer-application facts without changing their domain meanings.
behavior.performance: Filter/search/pagination reuse base hydrated KPI/aging model; source/business writes invalidate by normal full render.

deferredMechanismFinding.finding: Existing exact-preview workflow reuses Preview backend based only on function-name existence; must be repaired before R6 exact Preview so changed backend source cannot be tested against stale deployed callable.
